answers.explanation: Source behavior: DocumentViewSet declares IsAuthenticated and PaperlessObjectPermissions, and Download delegates the route pk and request to file_response with attachment disposition. The explicit Download-path resolver looks up request_doc by pk, derives root_doc, and tests request.user for owner-aware view_document permission on root_doc before selecting the effective file document. That helper allows when root_doc is unowned, owned by request.user, or guardian grants view_document on root_doc; otherwise the resolver returns 403. Because actual ownership and grants are unspecified, no concrete caller outcome can be selected. After that decision, effective-file selection may retain a requested version document, choose the latest document in the root's version family when no version is supplied, or resolve an explicit version id only if it is the root or has root_document_id equal to the root. The resulting file_doc—not necessarily root_doc—is passed to serve_file. If original is requested, or no archive exists, serve_file returns file_doc.source_file; otherwise it returns file_doc.archive_file. Thus version selection can change the Document whose bytes are returned, while the explicit owner-aware authorization object remains root_doc. Original versus archive changes only the representation of file_doc, not the checked object. Missing or invalid documents/versions produce not-found behavior rather than a file; the Download wrapper's try/except was source-read but remains flagged by the host as an unflattened interpretation gap.
